plan.title: Vendor bid sheet exposes editable price cells

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event create flow with a pricing stage.
Every publishable event needs a title.
Use an RFQ stage so the event exposes a vendor pricing bid sheet.
Configure the pricing stage before selecting its template.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a buyer line item that should appear on the vendor's bid sheet.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor whose portal will expose the bid sheet.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its pricing stage.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal, which is the subject of this test.
Open the event's pricing round and verify the vendor pricing bid sheet is rendered.
